verdict.rationale: A government employer-services portal like ESD's eServices/EAMS could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, chatbot or delegated-task agent. The documented workflows are manual online or paper filing guided by videos, and the authenticated portal could not be inspected.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
